title: Plurals (s/es)
goal: I can make singular words plural.
grammarFocus: Singular and plural nouns (-s/-es and irregular)

vocab.example: I have two boxes and both of them are full of toys.
Three children are playing while their parents watch.
Wash your feet before you get into bed.
He has two watches but he only wears one.
The babies are sleeping so we must be very quiet.
Two men are talking outside near the school gate.
